async def act(page):
    # Navigate to the filtered issues page for opened issues with enhancement label
    await page.goto('/root/metaseq/issues?state=opened&label_name[]=enhancement')
    # Wait for the page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Get all issue title links by their role and URL pattern
    issue_links = page.get_by_role('link')
    # Filter links that have href starting with '/root/metaseq/issues/' and are not labels or other elements
    # Since we cannot predict exact selectors after navigation, use a more generic approach
    # After navigation, the issue titles should be the main links with issue URLs
    titles = []
    for link in await issue_links.all():
        href = await link.get_attribute('href')
        if href and href.startswith('/root/metaseq/issues/') and not href.endswith('#notes'):
            title = await link.text_content()
            titles.append(title)
    # Return the list of titles as the result
    return titles
